start: Settings > Staff & sign-in, gym online, signed in as the owner

user_sees: Sheet 'Add a person' with a name box, 'Mobile number' with +91, and 'What is their job?' with Owner, Staff (front desk), Trainer, Other
must_not: The sheet for someone who is not an owner

steps.action: Type a name and a 10-digit number, pick 'Staff (front desk)'
user_sees: Under the list: 'Adds members, collects fees and checks members in. Never sees money totals.' (in a gym with branches: 'Works only at this branch: adds members, collects fees and checks members in. Never sees money totals.')
must_not: The owner’s hint under the Staff choice

user_sees: 'Adding…'
Toast '<name> added. Now make a sign-in code for them.'
A new row with the pill 'Staff', the number as +91 … and 'Make sign-in code'
must_not: Two rows for one tap
The person able to sign in before a code is made
Owner powers for a Staff choice

user_sees: 'Can do everything, including money totals.' (with branches: 'Can do everything in every branch, including money totals.')
must_not: No word that this person will see the money

user_sees: Toast '<name> added. Now make a sign-in code for them.'
Row pill 'Owner'
must_not: The person saved as front desk

user_sees: 'Same access as the front desk, plus the workout progress of the members you give them.'
must_not: A promise of more access than the front desk has

user_sees: Toast '<name> added. Now make a sign-in code for them.'
Row pill 'Trainer' and the Trainer tick on
must_not: The person added but not ticked as a trainer, with the plain "added" toast

steps.action: Repeat when the trainer tick cannot be saved
user_sees: Toast '<name> added with front desk access, but not marked as a trainer yet. Tick Trainer on their row.'
must_not: The person lost
A second person added on a retry

start: Sheet 'Add a person' (other kind: Other, with a typed job)

user_sees: A box 'Type the job (for example Manager, Cleaner)'
'Same access as the front desk. The job only shows next to their name.'
must_not: A typed job that changes what the person may do

user_sees: Toast '<name> added. Now make a sign-in code for them.'
Row pill 'Manager'
must_not: The pill 'Staff' while a job was typed
The job shown to members

start: Sheet 'Add a person', wrong or missing input; and people who may not add

user_sees: 'Type their name.'
must_not: A person with an empty name

user_sees: 'Type a 10-digit mobile number, like 98290 12345.'
must_not: A person saved with a number nobody can sign in with

steps.action: Pick 'Other', leave the job empty, tap 'Add'
user_sees: Under the job box: 'Type their job, like Manager or Cleaner.'
must_not: The person added as Other with no job
The message under the wrong box

steps.action: Add a number that is already on the list
user_sees: The server’s plain refusal in the sheet; the typed values stay
must_not: Two people with one mobile number
The sheet closing as if it worked

steps.action: Open Staff & sign-in as front desk staff
user_sees: No 'Add a person' button
must_not: The front desk adding an owner

steps.action: Open it in a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data). Then you and your staff can sign in with a mobile number, on any phone or computer.'
must_not: An Add button that cannot work

start: Staff & sign-in, a person added as Other with the job 'Manager' on a gym server that cannot yet keep typed jobs

steps.action: Look at the row on this browser
user_sees: Pill 'Manager'
must_not: Pill 'Staff' on the browser that typed the job

steps.action: Open the same screen on another device
user_sees: Pill 'Staff': the job is kept on the first browser only for now
must_not: A wrong job from another person

steps.action: Open the first browser again after the server can keep jobs
user_sees: The job is sent once, and the pill reads Manager on every device
must_not: The job sent again on every visit
A job the owner later cleared on the server coming back from the browser

user_sees: The row and its kept job are gone
must_not: The job showing on a new person who gets the same place

start: Sheet 'Add a person' and the rows

user_sees: Only Owner says "including money totals"; Staff says "Never sees money totals."
must_not: Trainer or Other given owner powers
A Staff, Trainer or Other person seeing money totals

user_sees: Their name and mobile number are kept for sign-in; they get in only with a code the owner makes
must_not: The mobile number shown to members
A sign-in code sent to anyone by itself

user_sees: They see workout progress only of members the owner gives them
must_not: Every member’s workout progress open to a new trainer
